UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -euo pipefail ROOT=\"{{$FullRootDir}}\" BASE=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" TMP=\"${ROOT}.amp-install\" TOOLS=\"${ROOT}.tools\" SPT_URL=\"https://spt-releases.modd.in/SPT-4.1.2-40743-cf04a11.7z\" mkdir -p \"$BASE\" \"$TMP\" \"$TOOLS\" if [ ! -x \"$TOOLS/7zzs\" ]; then echo \"[SPT] Downloading 7-Zip...\" curl -fL --retry 3 \"https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.00/7z2600-linux-x64.tar.xz\" -o \"$TMP/7z.tar.xz\" tar -xJf \"$TMP/7z.tar.xz\" -C \"$TOOLS\" chmod +x \"$TOOLS/7zzs\" fi echo \"[SPT] Downloading SPT 4.1.2...\" curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 3 \"$SPT_URL\" -o \"$TMP/SPT.7z\" rm -rf \"$TMP/extract\" mkdir -p \"$TMP/extract\" \"$TOOLS/7zzs\" x -y -aoa \"$TMP/SPT.7z\" \"-o$TMP/extract\" >/dev/null SRC=\"\" if [ -f \"$TMP/extract/SPT/SPT.Server.Linux\" ]; then SRC=\"$TMP/extract/SPT\" elif [ -f \"$TMP/extract/SPT.Server.Linux\" ]; then SRC=\"$TMP/extract\" else FOUND=\"$(find \"$TMP/extract\" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name SPT.Server.Linux -print -quit)\" [ -n \"$FOUND\" ] || { echo \"[SPT] ERROR: SPT.Server.Linux not found\"; exit 20; } SRC=\"$(dirname \"$FOUND\")\" fi echo \"[SPT] Installing from $SRC to $BASE\" find \"$BASE\" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} + cp -a \"$SRC\"/. \"$BASE\"/ chmod +x \"$BASE/SPT.Server.Linux\" find \"$BASE\" -maxdepth 2 -type f \\( -name \"*.Linux\" -o -name \"*.sh\" \\) -exec chmod +x {} + 2>/dev/null || true test -x \"$BASE/SPT.Server.Linux\" test -d \"$BASE/SPT_Data\" rm -rf \"$TMP\" echo \"[SPT] SPT 4.1.2 installation complete.\""
